name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. The text-to-speech API generated a valid MP3 audio file from the input text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." The output file (/home/daytona/output.mp3) is 43,511 bytes, confirmed by ffprobe as a proper MPEG-1 Layer III audio file at 44.1 kHz, 128 kbps, mono, ~2.69 seconds duration.
deviations: The quickstart example uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. In the sandbox environment (no audio output), I substituted `save(audio, "/home/daytona/output.mp3")` to save the generated audio to a file instead. This is the only deviation — the core API call, authentication, and text-to-speech generation followed the quickstart exactly.

friction.detail: The official example uses `play(audio)`, which requires an audio player like mpv, but headless sandboxes lack speakers and mpv, forcing the user to discover the `save()` alternative.
